A long and bloody war started by the royal bastard [[Ivar]] the Uncrowned. It began as a rebellion against his father [[Adrithyr]] Realmcrest on the basis of the murder of his mother and his right to the throne as the eldest son. Adrithyr recognizes his legitimate son Lukas Realmcrest (The Thunderlord) as the heir. Ivar represents the downtrodden and forgotten, acting as a “champion of the people”.
